faq.q1: How do I receive my account after buying?
faq.a1: The system automatically sends your account details via Telegram right after a successful payment. You can also review them in the Orders tab.
faq.a2: Warranty depends on each product type. Please contact support with your order ID for the fastest handling.
faq.q3: How do I top up my wallet?
faq.a3: Open the Profile tab, tap Deposit and choose the method available for your region (VietQR bank transfer or USDT).
faq.a4: For in-stock products, the account is delivered automatically right after a successful payment (usually under a minute).
